note: Queen, three-quarter, long dress with cape. Neck at the bottom of the beard (y~438); crown, hair and beard are head. Cape, belt, dress and its hem (y~847) are torso, so thighs and lower legs are hidden under the dress and carry no labels. Shoulders: left x~393 / right x~533 (the puffed shoulder cap is upper arm). Elbows halfway shoulder to wrist, y~524. Wrists y~603 left / y~612 right: the white frilled cuff belongs to the forearm sleeve, hands are bare skin. Ankle/shoe top y~849 (boots under the hem, only the black boot foot shows). No equipment.
